      public void start(javafx.stage.Stage stage) throws IOException

      public void updateModel()
      Updates the game model.

    • startGameLoop

      public void startGameLoop()
      Starts the game loop, allowing the game to run continuously. Sets the game loop state to running and not paused.

    • pauseGame

      public void pauseGame()
      Pauses the game. Stops the game loop and sets game to paused state. If all enemies are dead, triggers the ending method.

    • resumeGame

      public void resumeGame()
      Resumes the game

    • gameOver

      public void gameOver()
      Handles the game over condition. Ends the game. Sets the running state to false, stops the game loop, and triggers the "badEnd" method in the view.

    • ggwp

      public void ggwp()
      Handles the "ggwp" (good game, well played) condition. Ends the game. Sets the running state to false, stops the game loop, saves the player data, and triggers the "goodEnd" method in the view.

    • upgrade

      public void upgrade()
      Handles the upgrade event. Updates the game view, stops the game loop, sets the paused state to true, and triggers the "upgrade" method in the view.
